integrity: Exact character formulas, rational endpoint and logarithmic inequalities, and a self-contained checker support the theorem; floating-point comparisons alone are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification is restricted to the complete all-transposition Cayley metric on the five-letter symmetric group.
For exponents above the cutoff only small-bandwidth failure and sufficiently large-bandwidth positivity are proved.
Literature coverage is bounded; an unindexed exact computation may predate this analysis.
No independent mathematical audit or validation has been performed.
title: Exact negative-type threshold for the five-letter complete transposition metric
